data.name: Bad Pixels
data.detailed_description:
8-Bit first person shooter set in the old west! Have you ever wondered what a FPS game would look like in 8-bit? It's gotta look bad, right?

Bad Pixels is a gritty, hoodlum-shooting, gristle-chewing, law-avoiding retro style FPS. As Sheriff in this reckless retro environment, you must round up a team of deputies to help you flush out wrong doers, cash-in on wanted contracts and restore the peace.

(Get Deputies to do the dirty work for you!)

Features:

  • Classic first person “boomer shooter” style action.

  • Wild West themed antics.

  • RTS style deputy management system.

  • 16 main missions with various boss fights. (6 in current build)

  • 3 difficulty modes. (1 in current build)

  • Variety of interesting weapon types. (fists, pistol and TNT in current build)

  • Mission designer for custom missions. (coming soon)

  • 5 main environment types. (1 in current build)

  • SID Chiptune sound track and effects, in STEREO!

  • Numerous references to Commodore 64, Amiga and retro computing.

  • Grit!

Gameplay:

Choosing from a range of jobless drifters, assemble a team of hired deputies to take on missions, ranging from disturbances in the peace, to resolving dead or alive wanted notices. Enemies will not stand idly by for you to capture or kill them however, so your finest first person shooting skills are required to chase down these wrong doers, while also commanding your own team to control the scene.

Deputies:

Using an in-game menu, you can command your deputies to perform certain tasks, like patrolling, sentry and following. If a member of your team meets a grizzly end, they are gone forever. Try your best to keep them alive, so they may also reap the rewards between missions.

Environments:

In an 8-bit style, explore dusty towns, remote hills, snowy outposts and spooky graveyards. Great care has been taken to recreate these locations as realistically as possible using only the finest lines and polygons the 8-bit world has to offer.

Weapons:

Without getting too futuristic, there are some steam powered items to find, along with the usual knives (soon), pistols, shotguns (soon), rifles (soon) and … explosives!

Controls & Compatibility:

Along with the classic WASD + mouse controls, Bad Pixels can be played with most dual stick controllers.

Keyboard:
WASD + mouse for move and look.
R = reload
E = interact
SHIFT = sprint
2 = weapon down
3 = weapon up
Mouse scroll = weapon change
SPACE = crouch
LMB = shoot
RMB = jump
ESC = pause
TAB = console
- = shrink screen
+ = expand screen

Controller:
Left stick = move
Right stick = look
X = interact
Y = reload
A = Action
B = jump
collar buttons = weapons
triggers = duck and shoot


So grease up your 6 iron, don your stetson and shake them snakes outta your boots, we’re going on a wild ride!

data.short_description: Back in the days of the wild west, everything was much more rudimentary and raw. Drinking water had bits in it, shoes had holes in them, and computers only had 8-bits of processing power. With limited colors, resolution and audio, you too can relive those gritty days of old. It was Bad, Bad Pixels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
